quote: Unless otherwise provided by ordinance of the local authority having jurisdiction, a person shall not: Stop, stand or park a vehicle in any other alley in such a manner, or under such conditions as to leave available less than 10 feet of the width of the alley for the free movement of vehicular traffic.

activation.description: Vehicle stops, stands or parks in a qualifying other alley, subject to local ordinance.

obligation.description: Do not leave less than 10 feet available for free vehicular movement.

exceptions.source_clause: Unless otherwise provided by ordinance of the local authority having jurisdiction
exceptions.description: A controlling local ordinance may provide otherwise; effect is not presumed.

timing.description: Measure available width throughout the observed rest interval, with original 20 Hz joins.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: Unless otherwise provided by ordinance of the local authority having jurisdiction
judgment_calls_needed.note: Identify the actual jurisdiction and ordinance legal effect from independent source records.
Verify statutory alley identity, public highway, city block, rear access, abutting property and antecedent scope.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: Stop, stand or park a vehicle
judgment_calls_needed.note: The frozen cell selects park; original rest duration, purpose, occupant activity and alternative stop/stand status remain source reviewed.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: for the free movement of vehicular traffic
judgment_calls_needed.note: Retain continuous body and other-vehicle footprint evidence; do not infer legal free movement from width alone.
